description: Mobile and foldable runtime over Capacitor: device profile with live fold and unfold re-classification, orientation policy, safe-area insets, app lifecycle with a back-button stack, and a haptics facade.
rules: Pass Capacitor plugins in; the package never imports Capacitor.
Never force-rotate: decideOrientation only produces a hint.
Classify devices from injected ViewportFacts so thresholds unit-test without a browser.
Every subscription returns a disposer; call it on teardown.
